# nb1: local blink(1) control

Discover actual CLI help or MCP tools/list before use; source support does not prove installed support. This index grants no additional permissions.

## Contract

- High-level Action: set, off, fade, blink, breathe, pulse, alternate, orbit, rainbow.
- Low-level Sequence: timing serial or interval, ordered steps[], exact Hex6 targets, integer millisecond durations, repeat and on_finish. The daemon compiles and schedules animation.
- ColorInput: names, Hex3/6, RGB8, HSV (HSB in the UI) and explicit local @name references. No implicit gamma.
- Pattern: a computer-side saved normalized Sequence, independent of device storage generation.
- DeviceSequence: native RAM/Flash semantics with separate capabilities and deployment. Saving a host Pattern does not deploy it to hardware.

## Execution

HTTP POST /v1/preview compiles action, sequence or pattern_id without playing. POST /v1/jobs accepts the same expression plus serial and optional id. GET /v1/jobs/{id} tracks it; POST /v1/jobs/{id}/cancel requests cancellation.

MCP is real stdio to local HTTP, without a CLI subprocess or USB ownership. CLI control and the embedded Web use the same daemon core. Keep a single device owner.

Preserve endpoint, serial, input and Job ID before submitting. Omitted or empty IDs use j_ plus ten random Base32 characters. CLI and MCP generate IDs before sending. Accepted is not completed: query the original Job until terminal. On uncertainty, query the same ID without replaying. A missing record cannot prove nothing executed.

Matching ID, serial and input is deduplicated while retained. Active Jobs stay pinned; terminal Jobs remain up to 30 minutes in a 16,384-entry LRU cache. Reads do not renew expiration. Expiration, eviction or restart allows the ID to execute again. Capacity evicts old terminal records instead of rejecting new Jobs.

## References

- [OpenAPI 3.1](docs/api-v1.openapi.json): current machine-readable HTTP contract.
- [API v1](docs/api-v1.md): HTTP/CLI contract, colors, Patterns and limits.
- [Terminology](docs/api-v1-terminology.md): Action, Sequence, Step, Job, Pattern and DeviceSequence.
- [Agent skill](skills/blink1-control/SKILL.md): expression selection, tracking and recovery.
- [Local library](skills/blink1-control/references/patterns.md): named colors and saved Patterns.
- [MCP adapter](adapters/mcp/README.md): build, transport and tool schemas.

Report preview, terminal status, timestamped RGB readback and camera observation separately. Mac/MK2 evidence does not establish MK3, other-OS USB or optical quality. Public interfaces default to English and offer Chinese where available. Do not change global MCP registration, startup services or system permissions just to use this project.
